content.text: The ordinance includes three main obligations: Registration, Rent Control, and Just Cause for Eviction, plus Security Deposit Interest requirements.

content.text: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses (single-family homes with five or more rooms rented out individually with separate leases) receive full coverage including registration requirements, rent control, just cause for eviction protections, and security deposit interest.

content.text: New construction (built and received Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980), single-family homes with tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 1996, most condominiums, units with Section 202 or 811 subsidies, and units with certain HUD-related subsidies are partially covered with registration and security deposit interest, but without rent control.

content.text: Exempt units include "Golden Duplexes" (owner-occupied on December 31, 1979 with an owner currently living in one unit), units where the owner shares kitchen/bath with tenant, tenancies after November 7, 2018 on properties with an ADU where either unit is owner-occupied, university rental units such as dormitories, and nonprofit cooperatives.
**Not covered in this document:** Application/screening fees, screening restrictions, and algorithmic pricing are not addressed in this source material.
